exact: CD4-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T lymphocyte differentiation
related: CD4-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell development

definition: The process in which a precursor cell type acquires the specialized features of a CD4-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell. Intraepithelial T cells are found among epithelial cells in mucosal areas and have distinct phenotypes and developmental pathways.
label: CD4-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell differentiation
